reviewer: Codex source-by-source manual review, not blinded or independently adjudicated
scope: Stored headlines and cited visible evidence; no independent verification of article truth. Three subjects repeated, not independent holdout samples.
identity_policy: Accept unambiguous canonical team aliases as identity rather than invented news; retain mechanical failures unchanged. Expanded person names absent from the cited headline are reported as citation/name completeness issues rather than new-person invention.

reviews.subject: ac-milan

Valuation still interprets unspecified 60 million in report1.
